purpose: Determine whether a low-turnover, delta-neutral cross-venue perpetual funding carry between Binance USD-M and Hyperliquid is scientifically testable with outcome-independent provenance, cash-flow accounting, execution-cost, margin, collateral-fragmentation and stress assumptions frozen before Discovery outcomes are evaluated.
orientation_rationale: Frozen prospectively from external mechanism research before evaluating this lab's own economic outcomes; it may not be reversed or selected post hoc to rescue the candidate.

accounting_rules.margin: Binance and Hyperliquid margin states must be modeled independently; global portfolio equity may not rescue a venue-level liquidation
accounting_rules.collateral: pre-funded on both venues; instantaneous cross-venue collateral transfer prohibited
accounting_rules.maker_fills: not guaranteed; maker assumptions may only appear as a separately labeled sensitivity unless a prospectively frozen fill model is supported by provenance-quality data
accounting_rules.taker_fees: conservative baseline unless a stronger outcome-independent execution model is frozen before Discovery
accounting_rules.missing_execution_data: must remain missing or be classified UNOBSERVABLE; fixed favorable slippage or mid-price fills may not be invented

allowed_outputs_during_pre_freeze: GO_NO_GO readiness decision based only on provenance and model identifiability
stop_conditions: official funding settlement history cannot be reconstructed for both venues
funding timestamps cannot be normalized without ambiguity
material fee or margin regimes cannot be dated prospectively from primary evidence
basis or collateral effects required by the contract cannot be represented
execution-quality data are required for the primary claim but cannot be observed and no conservative non-execution claim remains scientifically meaningful
any step would require locked 2026 outcomes, MEXC locked data, authenticated account data, exchange mutation, live orders or paper trading
promotion_gate_to_full_freeze: All pre-freeze provenance, accounting, cost, margin, collateral, execution-data and discovery-partition rules must be explicit, machine-checkable where possible, and frozen before any economic outcome from the lab dataset is evaluated.
authority_boundary: This file authorizes specification, provenance and fail-closed infrastructure only. It does not authorize Discovery execution or trading.
